info.title: MyGPT Caddy VPS Command API
info.description: Runs authenticated, bounded, non-interactive Bash workflows on the connected VPS.

post.summary: Run a Bash workflow on the VPS
post.description: Runs one non-interactive Bash command or script. The current directory persists per OpenAI conversation. Nonzero shell exits are returned as HTTP 200 results. Large output is attached as downloadable text files.

200.description: Command result. Inspect exit_code, stderr, timed_out, and output_truncated.

400.description: Malformed JSON, invalid workdir, or invalid file reference.

command.description: Bash command or multiline script. Uploaded files are available in $OPENAI_FILE_DIR; metadata and absolute paths are JSON in $OPENAI_FILE_PATHS_JSON.

workdir.description: Optional absolute path or path relative to the conversation's current directory.

stdin.description: Optional standard input for the command.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional shorter timeout. The server always caps execution at 38 seconds.

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Up to 10 files from this conversation needed by the command. ChatGPT expands these references into temporary download objects at runtime.

exit_code.description: Shell exit code; nonzero is a command failure, not an HTTP failure.

stdout.description: Full inline stdout or a short tail when the full stream is attached.

stderr.description: Full inline stderr or a short tail when the full stream is attached.

output_truncated.description: True only when output exceeded the per-file 10 MB safety cap.

workdir.description: Conversation working directory after the command.

openaiFileResponse.description: Signed URLs for full text output files when inline output would be too large.
